executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

active.title: Programmazione automatica multi-settimana
active.outcome: The system maintains a coherent adaptive multi-week program.

exitCriteria.description: A durable versioned multi-week program represents week structure, sessions, progression targets and source decision evidence without silently overwriting prior versions.
Program generation and rollover consume validated readiness, workout, feedback, wearable and accepted visual evidence through bounded deterministic rules and fail closed on inconsistent inputs.
Week-to-week adaptation preserves completed history, explains each material change, enforces recovery and load bounds, and remains coherent after restart, retry and partial completion.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot multi-week rollover journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Lotti, scadenze, richiami e tracciabilità
active.outcome: Lot-level inventory and safety controls work end to end.

exitCriteria.description: Canonical durable lot records bind product, lot code, expiry, quantity/location state and provenance to authoritative inventory movements with complete operator attribution.
Receiving, sale, adjustment and transfer journeys preserve lot-level quantities transactionally and prevent expired, missing or inconsistent lot allocations from silently changing stock.
Expiry and recall controls produce deterministic actionable states, searchable affected inventory and auditable quarantine/release decisions without deleting historical traceability.
Duplicate, retried and concurrent lot operations remain idempotent and fail closed on conflicting lot identity, expiry or quantity evidence across locations.

Product CI, independent review, PFarma lot/expiry/recall delta Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge cumulative replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

active.title: Ricerca, filtri, duplicati e qualità archivio
active.outcome: The archive can be searched and cleaned without data loss.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated family-scoped search indexes durable canonical media metadata and organization fields and returns deterministic results after restart without leaking other family data.
Composable filters for time, media type, album, favorite and tags operate on canonical persisted metadata with explicit empty and invalid-query states.
Duplicate detection uses stable content/evidence identity, distinguishes exact from probable duplicates, and never deletes or merges canonical media without an explicit reversible decision.
Archive-quality actions are idempotent, authorization-enforced and reconcile safely with deleted/restored media while preserving audit and organization references.
Product CI, independent review, realistic Robot search/filter/duplicate-quality journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
